The shares are up 4842% over the past year and up 47% over the past month

reasoning: As an aggressive speculator, I've concentrated on highest-conviction long positions in AI and semiconductor winners (AMD, TSLA, GOOGL) with meaningful shorts in massively overextended names showing negative verdicts or extreme valuations (MU, AMAT, SNDK). I'm minimizing cash since price stability is not my goal—I'm hunting large quarter-plus-hold gains with positions sized for concentrated conviction, accepting downside risk in exchange for upside potential.
